title: Wire pack registration hook into the intake wizard (Phase D-3)
description: Wire the TASK-126 registry + TASK-127 collectors into runWizardAndWriteProjectMd() in bin/init.js at the two seams the investigation identified: (1) extend the question array handed to runQuestionnaire (~bin/init.js:489) with collectPackQuestions over the active-pack set; (2) merge applyProjectMdContributions into `answers` between answers-finalization (~bin/init.js:505) and the writeProjectMd call (~bin/init.js:519). The writeProjectMd/readProjectMd side already supports tier + perfil_proyecto (TASK-124), so NO change to src/project-md.js is needed. With the design-power pack active, DESIGN_PROFILE_QUESTIONS is asked and the scored tier/perfil_proyecto are written to PROJECT.md; with zero active packs, init behavior is byte-identical to today (hook is additive, off-by-default). This is the ticket that makes the Phase E design profile live end-to-end. Touches bin/ -> requires `npm run build:plugin` and the dist-parity gate; run `npm run test:all` at hand-off (mandatory-FULL surface: packaging/dist + core intake path). src/question-library.js must remain byte-unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: With the design-power pack active in the registry, a scripted init run (scripted prompter + tmp dir) asks the design_heavy gate + conditional interview and writes `tier` + `perfil_proyecto` to PROJECT.md; those fields round-trip through readProjectMd to exactly the values deriveProfileFields produced for the scripted answers.

With NO active packs, writeProjectMd output is byte-identical to the pre-change behavior — a regression lock (e.g. golden PROJECT.md or deep-equal of frontmatter) proving the hook is additive and off-by-default.
The two seams call ONLY the TASK-127 collectors; no other control-flow change in bin/init.js, and src/question-library.js is byte-unchanged (git diff empty).

dist/ is rebuilt via `npm run build:plugin` and the dist-parity gate (tests/e2e/dist-parity.spec.js) passes under `npm run test:all`; the regenerated dist/*.cjs bundle(s) are committed in the impl commit.
